			scope:modeu5_us04_proxy_estate_source_present > 0
			modeu5_stock_runtime_ready_trigger = yes
		}
		modeu5_read_country_stock_record = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = beer
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_country_stock_before_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_country_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_market_stock_before_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_market_stock }

		modeu5_add_stock = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = beer
			quantity = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity
			capacity_policy = allow_over_capacity
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_actual_added_quantity }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_goods_supply_delta value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity > 0 }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market = {
				add_goods_supply = {
					goods = goods:beer
					amount = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_delta
				}
			}
		}

		modeu5_read_country_stock_record = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = beer
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_country_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_market_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }

		scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market = {
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				value = { value = "market_price(goods:beer)" min = 0 }
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value
			value = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity
				multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				min = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value > 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity > 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_peasants_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_burghers_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_nobles_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_clergy_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country = {
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:peasants_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:clergy_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate } }
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { modeu5_audit_enabled_trigger = yes }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value }
			debug_log = "ModeU5 US-04 RESTORED good=beer requested=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity').GetValue|2] restored=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity').GetValue|2] goods_supply_added=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added').GetValue|2] estate_refund=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund').GetValue|2]"
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_store_monthly_reconciliation_record_good_beer = yes
}

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_beer = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_beer = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_beer = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_beer = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_beer = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_beer = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_beer = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_paper = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:paper
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:paper
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

			name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier
			value = {
				value = "variable_map(modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier|goods:paper)"

modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_paper = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_to_write
		value = {
			value = $value$
			min = 0.0001
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			is_key_in_variable_map = {
				name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
				target = goods:paper
			}
		}
		remove_from_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:paper
		}
	}
	add_to_variable_map = {
		name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
		key = goods:paper
		value = scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_to_write
	}
}

modeu5_set_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_paper = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = modeu5_us04_counter_satisfied_input
		value = {
			value = $satisfied_months$
			min = 0
		}
	}
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = modeu5_us04_counter_unsatisfied_input
		value = {
			value = $unsatisfied_months$
			min = 0
		}
	}
	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_paper = yes
	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_counter_satisfied_input > 0 }
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_satisfied_months
			key = goods:paper
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_counter_satisfied_input
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_counter_unsatisfied_input > 0 }
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_unsatisfied_months
			key = goods:paper
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_counter_unsatisfied_input
		}
	}
}

modeu5_us04_store_monthly_reconciliation_record_good_paper = {
	modeu5_us04_clear_monthly_reconciliation_record_good_paper = yes
	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity > 0 }
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_requested_quantity
			key = goods:paper
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity > 0 }
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_extra_quantity

			value = scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity
		}

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_actual_reconciled_quantity > 0 }
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_removed_quantity
			key = goods:paper
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_reconciled_quantity
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_removed_quantity > 0 }
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_goods_supply_removed_quantity
			key = goods:paper
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_removed_quantity
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity > 0 }
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_restored_quantity
			key = goods:paper
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity > 0 }
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_goods_supply_added_quantity
			key = goods:paper
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_reconciliation_quantity > 0 }
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_unsatisfied_quantity

		}
	}
	if = {

			name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge

		}
	}

modeu5_monthly_reconcile_country_market_pop_demand_good_paper = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			demands_goods_by_pops = goods:paper
		}
		scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country = {
			every_owned_location = {
				limit = { market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market }
				modeu5_monthly_reconcile_location_pop_demand_good_paper = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

modeu5_monthly_assess_country_market_estate_consumption_good_paper = {
	modeu5_monthly_reconcile_country_market_pop_demand_good_paper = yes
}

modeu5_monthly_reconcile_location_pop_demand_good_paper = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_location
	owner ?= { save_temporary_scope_as = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country }
	market = { save_temporary_scope_as = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market }

	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_paper = yes
	modeu5_read_us04_monthly_location_proxy_estate_quantities_good_paper = yes
	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_proxy_estate_source_present = 0 }
		modeu5_read_us04_monthly_pop_requested_quantity_good_paper = yes
		modeu5_read_us04_monthly_location_estate_requested_quantities_good_paper = yes
	}

	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_delta_ratio
		value = {
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
			subtract = 1
		}
	}
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = modeu5_us04_positive_reconciliation_delta_ratio
		value = {
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_delta_ratio
			min = 0
		}
	}
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_delta_ratio
		value = {
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_delta_ratio
			multiply = -1
			min = 0
		}
	}
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity_base value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity }
	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_proxy_estate_source_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity_base value = scope:modeu5_us04_proxy_estate_size_total }
	}
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity
		value = {
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity_base
			multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_positive_reconciliation_delta_ratio
			min = 0
		}
	}
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity
		value = {
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity_base
			multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_delta_ratio
			min = 0
		}
	}
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity_peasants_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity_peasants_estate multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_positive_reconciliation_delta_ratio min = 0 } }
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity_burghers_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity_burghers_estate multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_positive_reconciliation_delta_ratio min = 0 } }
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity_nobles_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity_nobles_estate multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_positive_reconciliation_delta_ratio min = 0 } }
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity_clergy_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity_clergy_estate multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_positive_reconciliation_delta_ratio min = 0 } }
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_peasants_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity_peasants_estate multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_delta_ratio min = 0 } }
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_burghers_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity_burghers_estate multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_delta_ratio min = 0 } }
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_nobles_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity_nobles_estate multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_delta_ratio min = 0 } }
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_clergy_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity_clergy_estate multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_delta_ratio min = 0 } }
	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_proxy_estate_source_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity_peasants_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_proxy_estate_size_peasants_estate multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_positive_reconciliation_delta_ratio min = 0 } }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity_burghers_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_proxy_estate_size_burghers_estate multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_positive_reconciliation_delta_ratio min = 0 } }

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_paper = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_paper = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_paper = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_paper = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_paper = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_paper = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_paper = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_books = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:books
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:books
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

	if = {

						target = goods:books
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient
			key = goods:books
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}

	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 0 }
	# Missing or invalid legacy state must fall back to multiplier 1, which
	# leaves the complete vanilla Pop-demand coefficient unchanged.

		limit = {
			has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier

				value = "variable_map(modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier|goods:books)"

		}
	}

			name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_requested_quantity
			key = goods:books
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity > 0 }
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_extra_quantity
			key = goods:books
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_actual_reconciled_quantity > 0 }
		add_to_variable_map = {

			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_extra_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_removed_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_reconciled_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_removed value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_removed_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_charge value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_value }
			debug_log = "ModeU5 US-04 RECONCILED good=books requested=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity').GetValue|2] extra=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_extra_quantity').GetValue|2] removed=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_removed_quantity').GetValue|2] goods_supply_removed=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_removed').GetValue|2] estate_charge=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_charge').GetValue|2]"
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0
			scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity > 0
			exists = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			exists = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			scope:modeu5_us04_proxy_estate_source_present > 0
			modeu5_stock_runtime_ready_trigger = yes
		}
		modeu5_read_country_stock_record = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = books
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_country_stock_before_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_country_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_market_stock_before_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_market_stock }

		modeu5_add_stock = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = books
			quantity = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity
			capacity_policy = allow_over_capacity
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_actual_added_quantity }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_goods_supply_delta value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity > 0 }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market = {
				add_goods_supply = {
					goods = goods:books
					amount = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_delta
				}
			}
		}

		modeu5_read_country_stock_record = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = books
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_country_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_market_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }

		scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market = {
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				value = { value = "market_price(goods:books)" min = 0 }
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value
			value = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity
				multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				min = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value > 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity > 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_peasants_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_burghers_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_nobles_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_clergy_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country = {
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:peasants_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:clergy_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate } }
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { modeu5_audit_enabled_trigger = yes }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value }
			debug_log = "ModeU5 US-04 RESTORED good=books requested=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity').GetValue|2] restored=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity').GetValue|2] goods_supply_added=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added').GetValue|2] estate_refund=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund').GetValue|2]"
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_store_monthly_reconciliation_record_good_books = yes
}

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_books = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_books = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_books = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_books = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_books = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_books = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_books = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_jewelry = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:jewelry
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:jewelry
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity_peasants_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_proxy_estate_size_peasants_estate multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value min = 0 } }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity_burghers_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_proxy_estate_size_burghers_estate multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value min = 0 } }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity_nobles_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_proxy_estate_size_nobles_estate multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value min = 0 } }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity_clergy_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_proxy_estate_size_clergy_estate multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value min = 0 } }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity_estate_total
			value = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity_peasants_estate
				add = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity_burghers_estate
				add = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity_nobles_estate
				add = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity_clergy_estate
				min = 0
			}
		}

	}

	save_temporary_scope_as = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market

		limit = {
			exists = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			demands_goods_by_pops = goods:jewelry
		}
		scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country = {
			every_owned_location = {
				limit = { market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market }
				modeu5_monthly_reconcile_location_pop_demand_good_jewelry = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

	save_temporary_scope_as = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_location
	owner ?= { save_temporary_scope_as = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country }
	market = { save_temporary_scope_as = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market }

	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_jewelry = yes
	modeu5_read_us04_monthly_location_proxy_estate_quantities_good_jewelry = yes
	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_proxy_estate_source_present = 0 }

		modeu5_read_us04_monthly_location_estate_requested_quantities_good_jewelry = yes
	}

		name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_delta_ratio
		value = {
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
			subtract = 1
		}
	}
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = modeu5_us04_positive_reconciliation_delta_ratio
		value = {
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_delta_ratio
			min = 0
		}
	}
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_delta_ratio
		value = {
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_delta_ratio
			multiply = -1
			min = 0
		}
	}
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity_base value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity }
	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_proxy_estate_source_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity_base value = scope:modeu5_us04_proxy_estate_size_total }
	}
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity
		value = {
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity_base
			multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_positive_reconciliation_delta_ratio
			min = 0
		}
	}
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity
		value = {
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity_base
			multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_delta_ratio
			min = 0
		}
	}

				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_jewelry = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_jewelry = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_jewelry = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_leather = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:leather
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:leather
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

			name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_value
			value = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_reconciled_quantity
				multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				min = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_value > 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity > 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_peasants_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity_peasants_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_burghers_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity_burghers_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_nobles_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity_nobles_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_clergy_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity_clergy_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_peasants_estate_negative value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_peasants_estate multiply = -1 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_burghers_estate_negative value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_burghers_estate multiply = -1 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_nobles_estate_negative value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_nobles_estate multiply = -1 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_clergy_estate_negative value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_clergy_estate multiply = -1 } }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country = {
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_peasants_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:peasants_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_peasants_estate_negative } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_burghers_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_burghers_estate_negative } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_nobles_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_nobles_estate_negative } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_clergy_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:clergy_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_clergy_estate_negative } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { modeu5_audit_enabled_trigger = yes }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_extra_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_removed_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_reconciled_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_removed value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_removed_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_charge value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_value }
			debug_log = "ModeU5 US-04 RECONCILED good=leather requested=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity').GetValue|2] extra=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_extra_quantity').GetValue|2] removed=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_removed_quantity').GetValue|2] goods_supply_removed=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_removed').GetValue|2] estate_charge=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_charge').GetValue|2]"
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0
			scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity > 0
			exists = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			exists = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			scope:modeu5_us04_proxy_estate_source_present > 0
			modeu5_stock_runtime_ready_trigger = yes
		}
		modeu5_read_country_stock_record = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = leather
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_country_stock_before_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_country_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_market_stock_before_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_market_stock }

		modeu5_add_stock = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = leather
			quantity = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity
			capacity_policy = allow_over_capacity
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_actual_added_quantity }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_goods_supply_delta value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity > 0 }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market = {
				add_goods_supply = {
					goods = goods:leather
					amount = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_delta
				}
			}
		}

		modeu5_read_country_stock_record = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = leather
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_country_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_market_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }

		scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market = {
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				value = { value = "market_price(goods:leather)" min = 0 }
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value
			value = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity
				multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				min = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value > 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity > 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_peasants_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_burghers_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_nobles_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_clergy_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country = {
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:peasants_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:clergy_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate } }
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { modeu5_audit_enabled_trigger = yes }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value }

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_leather = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_leather = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_leather = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_leather = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_leather = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_leather = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_leather = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_tools = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:tools
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:tools
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

					}

modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_tools = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 0 }
	# Missing or invalid legacy state must fall back to multiplier 1, which
	# leaves the complete vanilla Pop-demand coefficient unchanged.
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			is_key_in_variable_map = {
				name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
				target = goods:tools
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 1 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier
			value = {
				value = "variable_map(modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier|goods:tools)"
				min = 0.0001
			}
		}
	}
}

			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value }
			debug_log = "ModeU5 US-04 RESTORED good=tools requested=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity').GetValue|2] restored=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity').GetValue|2] goods_supply_added=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added').GetValue|2] estate_refund=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund').GetValue|2]"
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_store_monthly_reconciliation_record_good_tools = yes
}

modeu5_monthly_assess_location_estate_consumption_good_tools = {
	modeu5_monthly_reconcile_location_pop_demand_good_tools = yes

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_tools = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_tools = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_tools = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_tools = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_tools = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_tools = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_tools = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_masonry = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:masonry
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:masonry
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 0 }

	# leaves the complete vanilla Pop-demand coefficient unchanged.
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			is_key_in_variable_map = {
				name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
				target = goods:masonry
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 1 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier
			value = {
				value = "variable_map(modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier|goods:masonry)"
				min = 0.0001
			}
		}
	}
}

				target = goods:masonry
			}

		remove_from_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:masonry
		}

	add_to_variable_map = {
		name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
		key = goods:masonry
		value = scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_to_write
	}

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_masonry = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_masonry = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_masonry = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_masonry = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_masonry = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_masonry = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_masonry = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_lacquerware = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:lacquerware
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:lacquerware
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

				value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity
				multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				min = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value > 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity > 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_peasants_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_burghers_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_nobles_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_clergy_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country = {
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:peasants_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:clergy_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate } }
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { modeu5_audit_enabled_trigger = yes }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value }
			debug_log = "ModeU5 US-04 RESTORED good=lacquerware requested=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity').GetValue|2] restored=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity').GetValue|2] goods_supply_added=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added').GetValue|2] estate_refund=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund').GetValue|2]"
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_store_monthly_reconciliation_record_good_lacquerware = yes
}

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_lacquerware = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_lacquerware = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_lacquerware = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_lacquerware = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_lacquerware = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_lacquerware = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_lacquerware = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_pottery = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:pottery
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:pottery
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_pottery = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_pottery = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_pottery = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_pottery = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_pottery = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_pottery = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_pottery = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_furniture = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:furniture
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:furniture
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_furniture = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 0 }
	# Missing or invalid legacy state must fall back to multiplier 1, which
	# leaves the complete vanilla Pop-demand coefficient unchanged.
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			is_key_in_variable_map = {
				name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
				target = goods:furniture
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 1 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier
			value = {
				value = "variable_map(modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier|goods:furniture)"
				min = 0.0001
			}
		}
	}
}

			capacity_policy = allow_over_capacity
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_actual_added_quantity }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_goods_supply_delta value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity > 0 }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market = {
				add_goods_supply = {
					goods = goods:furniture
					amount = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_delta
				}
			}
		}

		modeu5_read_country_stock_record = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = furniture
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_country_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_market_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }

		scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market = {
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				value = { value = "market_price(goods:furniture)" min = 0 }
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value
			value = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity
				multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				min = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value > 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity > 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_peasants_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_burghers_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_nobles_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_clergy_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country = {
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:peasants_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:clergy_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate } }
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { modeu5_audit_enabled_trigger = yes }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value }
			debug_log = "ModeU5 US-04 RESTORED good=furniture requested=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity').GetValue|2] restored=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity').GetValue|2] goods_supply_added=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added').GetValue|2] estate_refund=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund').GetValue|2]"
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_store_monthly_reconciliation_record_good_furniture = yes
}

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_furniture = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_furniture = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_furniture = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_furniture = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_furniture = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_furniture = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_furniture = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_horses = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:horses
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:horses
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

modeu5_monthly_reconcile_country_market_pop_demand_good_horses = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			demands_goods_by_pops = goods:horses
		}
		scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country = {
			every_owned_location = {
				limit = { market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market }
				modeu5_monthly_reconcile_location_pop_demand_good_horses = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_horses = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_horses = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_horses = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_horses = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_horses = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_horses = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_horses = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_clay = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:clay
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:clay
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

modeu5_initialize_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_clay = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient
						target = goods:clay
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient
			key = goods:clay
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_clay = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 0 }
	# Missing or invalid legacy state must fall back to multiplier 1, which
	# leaves the complete vanilla Pop-demand coefficient unchanged.
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {

			name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_removed_quantity
			key = goods:clay
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_reconciled_quantity
		}
