			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_removed value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_removed_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_charge value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_value }
			debug_log = "ModeU5 US-04 RECONCILED good=clay requested=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity').GetValue|2] extra=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_extra_quantity').GetValue|2] removed=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_removed_quantity').GetValue|2] goods_supply_removed=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_removed').GetValue|2] estate_charge=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_charge').GetValue|2]"
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0
			scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity > 0
			exists = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			exists = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			scope:modeu5_us04_proxy_estate_source_present > 0
			modeu5_stock_runtime_ready_trigger = yes
		}
		modeu5_read_country_stock_record = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = clay
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_country_stock_before_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_country_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_market_stock_before_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_market_stock }

		modeu5_add_stock = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = clay
			quantity = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity
			capacity_policy = allow_over_capacity
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_actual_added_quantity }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_goods_supply_delta value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity > 0 }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market = {
				add_goods_supply = {
					goods = goods:clay
					amount = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_delta
				}
			}
		}

		modeu5_read_country_stock_record = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = clay
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_country_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_market_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }

		scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market = {
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				value = { value = "market_price(goods:clay)" min = 0 }
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value
			value = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity
				multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				min = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value > 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity > 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_peasants_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_burghers_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_nobles_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_clergy_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country = {
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:peasants_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:clergy_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate } }
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { modeu5_audit_enabled_trigger = yes }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value }
			debug_log = "ModeU5 US-04 RESTORED good=clay requested=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity').GetValue|2] restored=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity').GetValue|2] goods_supply_added=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added').GetValue|2] estate_refund=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund').GetValue|2]"
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_store_monthly_reconciliation_record_good_clay = yes
}

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_clay = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_clay = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_clay = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_clay = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_clay = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_clay = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_clay = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_sand = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:sand
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:sand
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

	# leaves the complete vanilla Pop-demand coefficient unchanged.

		limit = {
			has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			is_key_in_variable_map = {
				name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
				target = goods:sand
			}

		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier
			value = {
				value = "variable_map(modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier|goods:sand)"

		}
	}

				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_sand = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_sand = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_coal = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:coal
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:coal
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_coal = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 0 }
	# Missing or invalid legacy state must fall back to multiplier 1, which
	# leaves the complete vanilla Pop-demand coefficient unchanged.
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			is_key_in_variable_map = {
				name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
				target = goods:coal
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 1 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier
			value = {
				value = "variable_map(modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier|goods:coal)"
				min = 0.0001
			}
		}
	}
}

			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_clergy_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity_clergy_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_peasants_estate_negative value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_peasants_estate multiply = -1 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_burghers_estate_negative value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_burghers_estate multiply = -1 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_nobles_estate_negative value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_nobles_estate multiply = -1 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_clergy_estate_negative value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_clergy_estate multiply = -1 } }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country = {
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_peasants_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:peasants_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_peasants_estate_negative } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_burghers_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_burghers_estate_negative } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_nobles_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_nobles_estate_negative } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_clergy_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:clergy_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_clergy_estate_negative } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { modeu5_audit_enabled_trigger = yes }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_extra_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_removed_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_reconciled_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_removed value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_removed_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_charge value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_value }
			debug_log = "ModeU5 US-04 RECONCILED good=coal requested=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity').GetValue|2] extra=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_extra_quantity').GetValue|2] removed=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_removed_quantity').GetValue|2] goods_supply_removed=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_removed').GetValue|2] estate_charge=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_charge').GetValue|2]"
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0
			scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity > 0
			exists = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			exists = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			scope:modeu5_us04_proxy_estate_source_present > 0
			modeu5_stock_runtime_ready_trigger = yes
		}
		modeu5_read_country_stock_record = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = coal
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_country_stock_before_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_country_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_market_stock_before_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_market_stock }

		modeu5_add_stock = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = coal
			quantity = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity
			capacity_policy = allow_over_capacity
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_actual_added_quantity }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_goods_supply_delta value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity > 0 }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market = {
				add_goods_supply = {
					goods = goods:coal
					amount = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_delta
				}
			}
		}

		modeu5_read_country_stock_record = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = coal
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_country_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_market_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }

		scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market = {
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				value = { value = "market_price(goods:coal)" min = 0 }
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value
			value = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity
				multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				min = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value > 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity > 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_peasants_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_burghers_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_nobles_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_clergy_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country = {
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:peasants_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:clergy_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate } }
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { modeu5_audit_enabled_trigger = yes }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_coal = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_coal = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_coal = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_coal = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_coal = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_coal = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_coal = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_iron = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:iron
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:iron
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

	# leaves the complete vanilla Pop-demand coefficient unchanged.

		limit = {
			has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier

				name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
				target = goods:iron

			name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier
			value = {
				value = "variable_map(modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier|goods:iron)"

		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_store_monthly_reconciliation_record_good_iron = yes
}

modeu5_monthly_assess_location_estate_consumption_good_iron = {
	modeu5_monthly_reconcile_location_pop_demand_good_iron = yes

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_iron = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_iron = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_iron = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_iron = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_iron = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_iron = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_iron = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_copper = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:copper
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:copper
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

	# leaves the complete vanilla Pop-demand coefficient unchanged.

		limit = {
			has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier

				target = goods:copper
			}

			name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier
			value = {
				value = "variable_map(modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier|goods:copper)"

				name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price

			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_value
			value = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_reconciled_quantity
				multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				min = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_value > 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity > 0
			}

			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_clergy_estate_negative value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_clergy_estate multiply = -1 } }

				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_peasants_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:peasants_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_peasants_estate_negative } }

				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_clergy_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:clergy_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_clergy_estate_negative } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { modeu5_audit_enabled_trigger = yes }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity }

		}

	if = {

			exists = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			scope:modeu5_us04_proxy_estate_source_present > 0

		}
		modeu5_read_country_stock_record = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = copper
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_country_stock_before_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_country_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_market_stock_before_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_market_stock }

		modeu5_add_stock = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = copper
			quantity = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity
			capacity_policy = allow_over_capacity
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_actual_added_quantity }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_goods_supply_delta value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity > 0 }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market = {
				add_goods_supply = {
					goods = goods:copper
					amount = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_delta
				}
			}
		}

		modeu5_read_country_stock_record = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = copper
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_country_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_market_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }

		scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market = {
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				value = { value = "market_price(goods:copper)" min = 0 }
			}

			value = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity
				multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				min = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value > 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity > 0

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_copper = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_copper = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_copper = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_copper = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_copper = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_copper = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_copper = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_goods_gold = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:goods_gold
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:goods_gold
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_burghers_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_nobles_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_clergy_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country = {
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:peasants_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:clergy_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate } }
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { modeu5_audit_enabled_trigger = yes }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value }
			debug_log = "ModeU5 US-04 RESTORED good=goods_gold requested=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity').GetValue|2] restored=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity').GetValue|2] goods_supply_added=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added').GetValue|2] estate_refund=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund').GetValue|2]"
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_store_monthly_reconciliation_record_good_goods_gold = yes
}

	modeu5_monthly_reconcile_location_pop_demand_good_goods_gold = yes

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_goods_gold = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_goods_gold = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_goods_gold = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_goods_gold = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_goods_gold = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_goods_gold = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_goods_gold = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_silver = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:silver
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:silver
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_silver = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_silver = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_silver = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_silver = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_silver = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_silver = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_silver = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_stone = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:stone
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:stone
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_stone = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 0 }
	# Missing or invalid legacy state must fall back to multiplier 1, which
	# leaves the complete vanilla Pop-demand coefficient unchanged.
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			is_key_in_variable_map = {
				name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
				target = goods:stone
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 1 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier
			value = {
				value = "variable_map(modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier|goods:stone)"
				min = 0.0001
			}
		}
	}
}

		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_country_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_market_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }

		scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market = {
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				value = { value = "market_price(goods:stone)" min = 0 }
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value
			value = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity
				multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				min = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value > 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity > 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_peasants_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_burghers_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_nobles_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_clergy_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country = {
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:peasants_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:clergy_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate } }
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { modeu5_audit_enabled_trigger = yes }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value }
			debug_log = "ModeU5 US-04 RESTORED good=stone requested=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity').GetValue|2] restored=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity').GetValue|2] goods_supply_added=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added').GetValue|2] estate_refund=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund').GetValue|2]"
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_store_monthly_reconciliation_record_good_stone = yes
}

modeu5_monthly_assess_location_estate_consumption_good_stone = {
	modeu5_monthly_reconcile_location_pop_demand_good_stone = yes

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_stone = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_stone = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_stone = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_stone = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_stone = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_stone = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_stone = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_tin = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:tin
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:tin
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

	# leaves the complete vanilla Pop-demand coefficient unchanged.

		limit = {
			has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier

				name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
				target = goods:tin
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 1 }

			name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier
			value = {
				value = "variable_map(modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier|goods:tin)"

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_tin = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_tin = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_tin = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_tin = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_tin = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_tin = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_tin = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_lead = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:lead
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:lead
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

modeu5_initialize_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_lead = {
	if = {

					is_key_in_variable_map = {

						target = goods:lead
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {

modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_lead = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 0 }
	# Missing or invalid legacy state must fall back to multiplier 1, which
	# leaves the complete vanilla Pop-demand coefficient unchanged.
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			is_key_in_variable_map = {
				name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
				target = goods:lead
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 1 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier
			value = {
				value = "variable_map(modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier|goods:lead)"
				min = 0.0001
			}
		}
	}
}

		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_goods_supply_delta value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity > 0 }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market = {
				add_goods_supply = {
					goods = goods:lead
					amount = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_delta
				}
			}
		}

		modeu5_read_country_stock_record = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = lead
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_country_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_market_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }

		scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market = {
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				value = { value = "market_price(goods:lead)" min = 0 }
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value
			value = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity
				multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				min = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value > 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity > 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_peasants_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_burghers_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_nobles_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_clergy_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country = {
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:peasants_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:clergy_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate } }
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { modeu5_audit_enabled_trigger = yes }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value }
			debug_log = "ModeU5 US-04 RESTORED good=lead requested=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity').GetValue|2] restored=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity').GetValue|2] goods_supply_added=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added').GetValue|2] estate_refund=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund').GetValue|2]"
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_store_monthly_reconciliation_record_good_lead = yes
}

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_lead = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_lead = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_lead = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_lead = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_lead = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_lead = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_lead = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_silk = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:silk
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:silk
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_silk = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_silk = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_silk = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_silk = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_silk = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_silk = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_silk = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_dyes = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:dyes
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:dyes
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

	if = {

					is_key_in_variable_map = {

						target = goods:dyes
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient

modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_dyes = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 0 }
	# Missing or invalid legacy state must fall back to multiplier 1, which
	# leaves the complete vanilla Pop-demand coefficient unchanged.
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			is_key_in_variable_map = {
				name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
				target = goods:dyes
			}
		}

			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_charge value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_value }
			debug_log = "ModeU5 US-04 RECONCILED good=dyes requested=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity').GetValue|2] extra=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_extra_quantity').GetValue|2] removed=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_removed_quantity').GetValue|2] goods_supply_removed=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_removed').GetValue|2] estate_charge=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_charge').GetValue|2]"
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0
			scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity > 0
			exists = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			exists = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			scope:modeu5_us04_proxy_estate_source_present > 0
			modeu5_stock_runtime_ready_trigger = yes
		}
		modeu5_read_country_stock_record = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = dyes
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_country_stock_before_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_country_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_market_stock_before_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_market_stock }

		modeu5_add_stock = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = dyes
			quantity = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity
			capacity_policy = allow_over_capacity
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_actual_added_quantity }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_goods_supply_delta value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity > 0 }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market = {
				add_goods_supply = {
					goods = goods:dyes
					amount = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_delta
				}
			}
		}

		modeu5_read_country_stock_record = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = dyes
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_country_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_market_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }

		scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market = {
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				value = { value = "market_price(goods:dyes)" min = 0 }
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value
			value = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity
				multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				min = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value > 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity > 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_peasants_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_burghers_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_nobles_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_clergy_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country = {
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:peasants_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:clergy_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate } }
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { modeu5_audit_enabled_trigger = yes }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value }
			debug_log = "ModeU5 US-04 RESTORED good=dyes requested=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity').GetValue|2] restored=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity').GetValue|2] goods_supply_added=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added').GetValue|2] estate_refund=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund').GetValue|2]"
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_store_monthly_reconciliation_record_good_dyes = yes
}

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_dyes = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_dyes = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_dyes = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_dyes = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_dyes = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_dyes = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_dyes = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_incense = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:incense
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:incense
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

				value = "variable_map(modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier|goods:incense)"

		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_incense = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_incense = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_incense = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_tea = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:tea
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:tea
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_tea = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 0 }
	# Missing or invalid legacy state must fall back to multiplier 1, which
	# leaves the complete vanilla Pop-demand coefficient unchanged.
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			is_key_in_variable_map = {
				name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
				target = goods:tea
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 1 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier
			value = {
				value = "variable_map(modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier|goods:tea)"
				min = 0.0001
			}
		}
	}
}

			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_burghers_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity_burghers_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_nobles_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity_nobles_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_clergy_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity_clergy_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_peasants_estate_negative value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_peasants_estate multiply = -1 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_burghers_estate_negative value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_burghers_estate multiply = -1 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_nobles_estate_negative value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_nobles_estate multiply = -1 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_clergy_estate_negative value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_clergy_estate multiply = -1 } }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country = {
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_peasants_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:peasants_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_peasants_estate_negative } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_burghers_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_burghers_estate_negative } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_nobles_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_nobles_estate_negative } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_clergy_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:clergy_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_clergy_estate_negative } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { modeu5_audit_enabled_trigger = yes }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_extra_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity }

	}

	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0
			scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity > 0
			exists = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			exists = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			scope:modeu5_us04_proxy_estate_source_present > 0
			modeu5_stock_runtime_ready_trigger = yes
		}
		modeu5_read_country_stock_record = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = tea
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_country_stock_before_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_country_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_market_stock_before_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_market_stock }

		modeu5_add_stock = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = tea
			quantity = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity
			capacity_policy = allow_over_capacity
		}
