		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_goods_supply_delta value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity > 0 }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market = {
				add_goods_supply = {
					goods = goods:tea
					amount = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_delta
				}
			}
		}

		modeu5_read_country_stock_record = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = tea
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_country_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_market_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }

		scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market = {
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				value = { value = "market_price(goods:tea)" min = 0 }
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value
			value = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity
				multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				min = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value > 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity > 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_peasants_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_burghers_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_nobles_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }

				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:peasants_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate } }

				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate } }

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_tea = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_tea = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_tea = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_tea = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_tea = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_tea = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_tea = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_cocoa = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:cocoa
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:cocoa
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value }
			debug_log = "ModeU5 US-04 RESTORED good=cocoa requested=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity').GetValue|2] restored=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity').GetValue|2] goods_supply_added=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added').GetValue|2] estate_refund=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund').GetValue|2]"
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_store_monthly_reconciliation_record_good_cocoa = yes
}

modeu5_monthly_assess_location_estate_consumption_good_cocoa = {
	modeu5_monthly_reconcile_location_pop_demand_good_cocoa = yes

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_cocoa = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_cocoa = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_cocoa = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_cocoa = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_cocoa = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_cocoa = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_cocoa = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_coffee = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:coffee
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:coffee
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

				value = "variable_map(modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier|goods:coffee)"

		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_coffee = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_coffee = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_coffee = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_coffee = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_coffee = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_coffee = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_coffee = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_fiber_crops = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:fiber_crops
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:fiber_crops
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }

		scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market = {
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				value = { value = "market_price(goods:fiber_crops)" min = 0 }
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value
			value = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity
				multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				min = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value > 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity > 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_peasants_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_burghers_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_nobles_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_clergy_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country = {
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:peasants_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:clergy_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate } }
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { modeu5_audit_enabled_trigger = yes }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value }
			debug_log = "ModeU5 US-04 RESTORED good=fiber_crops requested=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity').GetValue|2] restored=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity').GetValue|2] goods_supply_added=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added').GetValue|2] estate_refund=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund').GetValue|2]"
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_store_monthly_reconciliation_record_good_fiber_crops = yes
}

	modeu5_monthly_reconcile_location_pop_demand_good_fiber_crops = yes

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_fiber_crops = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_fiber_crops = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_fiber_crops = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_fiber_crops = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_fiber_crops = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_fiber_crops = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_fiber_crops = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_ivory = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:ivory
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:ivory
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_ivory = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_ivory = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_ivory = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_ivory = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_ivory = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_ivory = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_ivory = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_lumber = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:lumber
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:lumber
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

modeu5_initialize_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_lumber = {
	if = {
		limit = {

					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient
						target = goods:lumber
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient
			key = goods:lumber
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}

}

modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_lumber = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 0 }
	# Missing or invalid legacy state must fall back to multiplier 1, which
	# leaves the complete vanilla Pop-demand coefficient unchanged.
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			is_key_in_variable_map = {
				name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
				target = goods:lumber
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 1 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier
			value = {
				value = "variable_map(modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier|goods:lumber)"
				min = 0.0001
			}
		}
	}
}

		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_country_stock_before_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_country_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_market_stock_before_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_market_stock }

		modeu5_add_stock = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = lumber
			quantity = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity
			capacity_policy = allow_over_capacity
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_actual_added_quantity }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_goods_supply_delta value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity > 0 }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market = {
				add_goods_supply = {
					goods = goods:lumber
					amount = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_delta
				}
			}
		}

		modeu5_read_country_stock_record = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = lumber
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_country_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_market_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }

		scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market = {
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				value = { value = "market_price(goods:lumber)" min = 0 }
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value
			value = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity
				multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				min = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value > 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity > 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_peasants_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_burghers_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_nobles_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_clergy_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country = {
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:peasants_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:clergy_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate } }
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { modeu5_audit_enabled_trigger = yes }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value }
			debug_log = "ModeU5 US-04 RESTORED good=lumber requested=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity').GetValue|2] restored=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity').GetValue|2] goods_supply_added=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added').GetValue|2] estate_refund=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund').GetValue|2]"
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_store_monthly_reconciliation_record_good_lumber = yes
}

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_lumber = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_lumber = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_lumber = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_lumber = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_lumber = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_lumber = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_lumber = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_salt = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:salt
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:salt
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 0 }
	# Missing or invalid legacy state must fall back to multiplier 1, which
	# leaves the complete vanilla Pop-demand coefficient unchanged.
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			is_key_in_variable_map = {
				name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
				target = goods:salt
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 1 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier
			value = {
				value = "variable_map(modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier|goods:salt)"
				min = 0.0001
			}
		}
	}
}

modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_salt = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_to_write
		value = {
			value = $value$
			min = 0.0001
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			is_key_in_variable_map = {
				name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
				target = goods:salt

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_salt = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_salt = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_salt = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_salt = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_salt = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_salt = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_salt = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_medicaments = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:medicaments
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:medicaments
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

modeu5_initialize_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_medicaments = {
	if = {

					is_key_in_variable_map = {

						target = goods:medicaments
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient

modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_medicaments = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 0 }
	# Missing or invalid legacy state must fall back to multiplier 1, which
	# leaves the complete vanilla Pop-demand coefficient unchanged.
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {

		}
		if = {
			limit = { modeu5_audit_enabled_trigger = yes }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_extra_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_removed_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_reconciled_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_removed value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_removed_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_charge value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_value }
			debug_log = "ModeU5 US-04 RECONCILED good=medicaments requested=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity').GetValue|2] extra=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_extra_quantity').GetValue|2] removed=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_removed_quantity').GetValue|2] goods_supply_removed=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_removed').GetValue|2] estate_charge=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_charge').GetValue|2]"
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0
			scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity > 0
			exists = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			exists = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			scope:modeu5_us04_proxy_estate_source_present > 0
			modeu5_stock_runtime_ready_trigger = yes
		}
		modeu5_read_country_stock_record = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = medicaments
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_country_stock_before_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_country_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_market_stock_before_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_market_stock }

		modeu5_add_stock = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = medicaments
			quantity = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity
			capacity_policy = allow_over_capacity
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_actual_added_quantity }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_goods_supply_delta value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity > 0 }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market = {
				add_goods_supply = {
					goods = goods:medicaments
					amount = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_delta
				}
			}
		}

		modeu5_read_country_stock_record = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = medicaments
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_country_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_market_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }

		scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market = {
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				value = { value = "market_price(goods:medicaments)" min = 0 }
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value
			value = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity
				multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				min = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value > 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity > 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_peasants_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_burghers_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_nobles_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_clergy_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country = {
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:peasants_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:clergy_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate } }
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { modeu5_audit_enabled_trigger = yes }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value }
			debug_log = "ModeU5 US-04 RESTORED good=medicaments requested=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity').GetValue|2] restored=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity').GetValue|2] goods_supply_added=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added').GetValue|2] estate_refund=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund').GetValue|2]"
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_store_monthly_reconciliation_record_good_medicaments = yes
}

	modeu5_monthly_reconcile_location_pop_demand_good_medicaments = yes

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_medicaments = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_medicaments = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_medicaments = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_medicaments = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_medicaments = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_medicaments = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_medicaments = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_gems = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:gems
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:gems
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

					}

	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 0 }
	# Missing or invalid legacy state must fall back to multiplier 1, which
	# leaves the complete vanilla Pop-demand coefficient unchanged.
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			is_key_in_variable_map = {
				name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
				target = goods:gems
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 1 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier
			value = {
				value = "variable_map(modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier|goods:gems)"
				min = 0.0001
			}
		}
	}
}

			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_gems = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_gems = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_gems = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_pearls = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:pearls
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:pearls
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_pearls = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 0 }
	# Missing or invalid legacy state must fall back to multiplier 1, which
	# leaves the complete vanilla Pop-demand coefficient unchanged.
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			is_key_in_variable_map = {
				name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
				target = goods:pearls
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 1 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier
			value = {
				value = "variable_map(modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier|goods:pearls)"
				min = 0.0001
			}
		}
	}
}

			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_peasants_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity_peasants_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_burghers_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity_burghers_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_nobles_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity_nobles_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_clergy_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity_clergy_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_peasants_estate_negative value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_peasants_estate multiply = -1 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_burghers_estate_negative value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_burghers_estate multiply = -1 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_nobles_estate_negative value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_nobles_estate multiply = -1 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_clergy_estate_negative value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_clergy_estate multiply = -1 } }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country = {
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_peasants_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:peasants_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_peasants_estate_negative } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_burghers_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_burghers_estate_negative } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_nobles_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_nobles_estate_negative } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_clergy_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:clergy_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_clergy_estate_negative } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { modeu5_audit_enabled_trigger = yes }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_extra_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_removed_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_reconciled_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_removed value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_removed_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_charge value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_value }
			debug_log = "ModeU5 US-04 RECONCILED good=pearls requested=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity').GetValue|2] extra=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_extra_quantity').GetValue|2] removed=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_removed_quantity').GetValue|2] goods_supply_removed=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_removed').GetValue|2] estate_charge=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_charge').GetValue|2]"
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0
			scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity > 0
			exists = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			exists = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			scope:modeu5_us04_proxy_estate_source_present > 0
			modeu5_stock_runtime_ready_trigger = yes
		}
		modeu5_read_country_stock_record = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = pearls
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_country_stock_before_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_country_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_market_stock_before_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_market_stock }

		modeu5_add_stock = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = pearls
			quantity = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity
			capacity_policy = allow_over_capacity
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_actual_added_quantity }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_goods_supply_delta value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity > 0 }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market = {
				add_goods_supply = {
					goods = goods:pearls
					amount = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_delta
				}
			}
		}

		modeu5_read_country_stock_record = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = pearls
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_country_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_market_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }

		scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market = {
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				value = { value = "market_price(goods:pearls)" min = 0 }
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value
			value = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity
				multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				min = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value > 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity > 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_peasants_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_burghers_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_nobles_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_clergy_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }

				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:peasants_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:clergy_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate } }
			}
		}

		if = {

			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_pearls = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_pearls = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_pearls = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_pearls = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_pearls = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_pearls = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_pearls = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_amber = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:amber
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:amber
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

			debug_log = "ModeU5 US-04 RESTORED good=amber requested=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity').GetValue|2] restored=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity').GetValue|2] goods_supply_added=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added').GetValue|2] estate_refund=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund').GetValue|2]"
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_store_monthly_reconciliation_record_good_amber = yes
}

modeu5_monthly_assess_location_estate_consumption_good_amber = {
	modeu5_monthly_reconcile_location_pop_demand_good_amber = yes
}

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_amber = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_amber = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_amber = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_amber = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_amber = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_amber = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_amber = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_saltpeter = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:saltpeter
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:saltpeter
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_saltpeter = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 0 }
	# Missing or invalid legacy state must fall back to multiplier 1, which
	# leaves the complete vanilla Pop-demand coefficient unchanged.
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			is_key_in_variable_map = {
				name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
				target = goods:saltpeter
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 1 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier
			value = {
				value = "variable_map(modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier|goods:saltpeter)"
				min = 0.0001
			}
		}
	}
}

	}

			}

		if = {

			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = saltpeter
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_country_stock_before_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_country_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_market_stock_before_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_market_stock }

		modeu5_add_stock = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = saltpeter
			quantity = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity
			capacity_policy = allow_over_capacity
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_actual_added_quantity }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_goods_supply_delta value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity > 0 }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market = {
				add_goods_supply = {
					goods = goods:saltpeter
					amount = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_delta
				}
			}
		}

		modeu5_read_country_stock_record = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = saltpeter
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_country_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_market_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }

			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_burghers_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_saltpeter = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_saltpeter = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_saltpeter = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_saltpeter = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_saltpeter = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_saltpeter = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_saltpeter = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_alum = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:alum
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:alum
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

	# leaves the complete vanilla Pop-demand coefficient unchanged.

			name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier
			value = {
				value = "variable_map(modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier|goods:alum)"

	}

			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_peasants_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_burghers_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_nobles_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_clergy_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country = {
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:peasants_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:clergy_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate } }
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { modeu5_audit_enabled_trigger = yes }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value }
			debug_log = "ModeU5 US-04 RESTORED good=alum requested=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity').GetValue|2] restored=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity').GetValue|2] goods_supply_added=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added').GetValue|2] estate_refund=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund').GetValue|2]"
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_store_monthly_reconciliation_record_good_alum = yes
}

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_alum = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_alum = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_alum = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_alum = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_alum = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_alum = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_alum = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_wine = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:wine
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:wine
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

			min = 0
		}

			value = scope:modeu5_us04_counter_satisfied_input
		}
	}

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_wine = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_wine = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_wine = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_wine = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_wine = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_wine = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_wine = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_elephants = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:elephants
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:elephants
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_elephants = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 0 }
	# Missing or invalid legacy state must fall back to multiplier 1, which
	# leaves the complete vanilla Pop-demand coefficient unchanged.
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			is_key_in_variable_map = {
				name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
				target = goods:elephants
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 1 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier
			value = {
				value = "variable_map(modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier|goods:elephants)"
				min = 0.0001
			}
		}
	}
}
