		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }

		scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market = {
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				value = { value = "market_price(goods:elephants)" min = 0 }
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value
			value = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity
				multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				min = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value > 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity > 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_peasants_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_burghers_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_nobles_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_clergy_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country = {
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:peasants_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:clergy_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate } }
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { modeu5_audit_enabled_trigger = yes }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value }
			debug_log = "ModeU5 US-04 RESTORED good=elephants requested=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity').GetValue|2] restored=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity').GetValue|2] goods_supply_added=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added').GetValue|2] estate_refund=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund').GetValue|2]"
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_store_monthly_reconciliation_record_good_elephants = yes

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_elephants = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_elephants = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_elephants = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_elephants = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_elephants = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_elephants = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_elephants = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_marble = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:marble
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:marble
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_marble = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_marble = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_marble = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_marble = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_marble = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_marble = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_marble = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_mercury = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:mercury
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:mercury
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

modeu5_initialize_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_mercury = {
	if = {

					is_key_in_variable_map = {

						target = goods:mercury
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient
			key = goods:mercury
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"

modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_mercury = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 0 }
	# Missing or invalid legacy state must fall back to multiplier 1, which
	# leaves the complete vanilla Pop-demand coefficient unchanged.
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			is_key_in_variable_map = {
				name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
				target = goods:mercury
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 1 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier
			value = {
				value = "variable_map(modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier|goods:mercury)"
				min = 0.0001
			}
		}
	}
}

			exists = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			scope:modeu5_us04_proxy_estate_source_present > 0
			modeu5_stock_runtime_ready_trigger = yes
		}
		modeu5_read_country_stock_record = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = mercury
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_country_stock_before_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_country_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_market_stock_before_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_market_stock }

		modeu5_add_stock = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = mercury
			quantity = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity
			capacity_policy = allow_over_capacity
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_actual_added_quantity }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_goods_supply_delta value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity > 0 }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market = {
				add_goods_supply = {
					goods = goods:mercury
					amount = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_delta
				}
			}
		}

		modeu5_read_country_stock_record = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = mercury
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_country_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_market_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }

		scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market = {
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				value = { value = "market_price(goods:mercury)" min = 0 }
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value
			value = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity
				multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				min = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value > 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity > 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_peasants_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_burghers_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_nobles_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_clergy_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country = {
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:peasants_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:clergy_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate } }
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { modeu5_audit_enabled_trigger = yes }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value }
			debug_log = "ModeU5 US-04 RESTORED good=mercury requested=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity').GetValue|2] restored=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity').GetValue|2] goods_supply_added=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added').GetValue|2] estate_refund=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund').GetValue|2]"
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_store_monthly_reconciliation_record_good_mercury = yes
}

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_mercury = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_mercury = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_mercury = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_mercury = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_mercury = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_mercury = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_mercury = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_saffron = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:saffron
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:saffron
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_saffron = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_saffron = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_saffron = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_saffron = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_saffron = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_saffron = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_saffron = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_pepper = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:pepper
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier

	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 0 }
	# Missing or invalid legacy state must fall back to multiplier 1, which
	# leaves the complete vanilla Pop-demand coefficient unchanged.
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			is_key_in_variable_map = {
				name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
				target = goods:pepper
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 1 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier
			value = {
				value = "variable_map(modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier|goods:pepper)"
				min = 0.0001
			}
		}
	}
}

			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_burghers_estate_negative value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_burghers_estate multiply = -1 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_nobles_estate_negative value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_nobles_estate multiply = -1 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_clergy_estate_negative value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_clergy_estate multiply = -1 } }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country = {
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_peasants_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:peasants_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_peasants_estate_negative } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_burghers_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_burghers_estate_negative } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_nobles_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_nobles_estate_negative } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_clergy_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:clergy_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_clergy_estate_negative } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { modeu5_audit_enabled_trigger = yes }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_extra_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_removed_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_reconciled_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_removed value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_removed_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_charge value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_charge_value }
			debug_log = "ModeU5 US-04 RECONCILED good=pepper requested=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity').GetValue|2] extra=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_extra_quantity').GetValue|2] removed=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_removed_quantity').GetValue|2] goods_supply_removed=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_removed').GetValue|2] estate_charge=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_charge').GetValue|2]"
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0
			scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity > 0
			exists = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			exists = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			scope:modeu5_us04_proxy_estate_source_present > 0
			modeu5_stock_runtime_ready_trigger = yes
		}
		modeu5_read_country_stock_record = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = pepper
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_country_stock_before_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_country_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_market_stock_before_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_market_stock }

		modeu5_add_stock = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = pepper
			quantity = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity
			capacity_policy = allow_over_capacity
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_actual_added_quantity }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_goods_supply_delta value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity > 0 }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market = {
				add_goods_supply = {
					goods = goods:pepper
					amount = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_delta
				}
			}
		}

		modeu5_read_country_stock_record = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = pepper
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_country_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_market_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }

		scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market = {
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				value = { value = "market_price(goods:pepper)" min = 0 }
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value
			value = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity
				multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				min = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value > 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity > 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_peasants_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_burghers_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_nobles_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_clergy_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country = {
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:peasants_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:clergy_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate } }
			}
		}

		if = {

			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_pepper = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_pepper = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_pepper = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_pepper = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_pepper = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_pepper = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_pepper = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_cloves = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:cloves
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:cloves
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_cloves = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_cloves = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_cloves = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_cloves = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_cloves = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_cloves = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_cloves = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_chili = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:chili
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:chili
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 0 }
	# Missing or invalid legacy state must fall back to multiplier 1, which
	# leaves the complete vanilla Pop-demand coefficient unchanged.
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			is_key_in_variable_map = {
				name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
				target = goods:chili
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 1 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier
			value = {
				value = "variable_map(modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier|goods:chili)"
				min = 0.0001
			}
		}
	}
}

		}

				value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_reconciled_quantity
				multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				min = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {

				scope:modeu5_us04_extra_reconciliation_quantity > 0

			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { modeu5_audit_enabled_trigger = yes }

	if = {

			exists = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market

		}

			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = chili
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_country_stock_before_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_country_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_market_stock_before_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_market_stock }

		modeu5_add_stock = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = chili
			quantity = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity
			capacity_policy = allow_over_capacity
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_actual_added_quantity }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_goods_supply_delta value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity > 0 }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market = {
				add_goods_supply = {
					goods = goods:chili
					amount = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_delta
				}
			}
		}

		modeu5_read_country_stock_record = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = chili
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_country_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_market_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }

			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price

				min = 0
			}

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_chili = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_chili = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_chili = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_chili = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_chili = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_chili = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_chili = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_wool = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:wool
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:wool
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_clergy_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country = {
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:peasants_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:clergy_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate } }
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { modeu5_audit_enabled_trigger = yes }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value }
			debug_log = "ModeU5 US-04 RESTORED good=wool requested=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity').GetValue|2] restored=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity').GetValue|2] goods_supply_added=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added').GetValue|2] estate_refund=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund').GetValue|2]"
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_store_monthly_reconciliation_record_good_wool = yes
}

	modeu5_monthly_reconcile_location_pop_demand_good_wool = yes

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_wool = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_wool = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_wool = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_wool = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_wool = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_wool = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_wool = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_wild_game = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:wild_game
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:wild_game
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_wild_game = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_wild_game = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_wild_game = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_wild_game = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_wild_game = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_wild_game = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_wild_game = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_fur = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:fur
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:fur
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

	# leaves the complete vanilla Pop-demand coefficient unchanged.
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			is_key_in_variable_map = {
				name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
				target = goods:fur
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 1 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier
			value = {
				value = "variable_map(modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier|goods:fur)"
				min = 0.0001
			}
		}
	}

		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_country_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_market_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }

		scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market = {
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				value = { value = "market_price(goods:fur)" min = 0 }
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value
			value = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity
				multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				min = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value > 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity > 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_peasants_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_burghers_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_nobles_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_clergy_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country = {
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:peasants_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:clergy_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate } }
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { modeu5_audit_enabled_trigger = yes }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value }
			debug_log = "ModeU5 US-04 RESTORED good=fur requested=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity').GetValue|2] restored=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity').GetValue|2] goods_supply_added=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added').GetValue|2] estate_refund=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund').GetValue|2]"
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_store_monthly_reconciliation_record_good_fur = yes
}

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_fur = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_fur = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_fur = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_fur = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_fur = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_fur = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_fur = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_fish = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:fish
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:fish
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_fish = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_fish = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_fish = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_fish = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_fish = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_fish = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_fish = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_wheat = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:wheat
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:wheat
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_wheat = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 0 }
	# Missing or invalid legacy state must fall back to multiplier 1, which
	# leaves the complete vanilla Pop-demand coefficient unchanged.
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			is_key_in_variable_map = {
				name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
				target = goods:wheat
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 1 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier
			value = {
				value = "variable_map(modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier|goods:wheat)"
				min = 0.0001
			}
		}
	}
}

			capacity_policy = allow_over_capacity
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_actual_added_quantity }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_goods_supply_delta value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity > 0 }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market = {
				add_goods_supply = {
					goods = goods:wheat
					amount = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_delta
				}
			}
		}

		modeu5_read_country_stock_record = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = wheat
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_country_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_market_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }

		scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market = {
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				value = { value = "market_price(goods:wheat)" min = 0 }
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value
			value = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity
				multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				min = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value > 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity > 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_peasants_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_burghers_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_nobles_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_clergy_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country = {
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:peasants_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:clergy_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate } }
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { modeu5_audit_enabled_trigger = yes }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value }
			debug_log = "ModeU5 US-04 RESTORED good=wheat requested=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity').GetValue|2] restored=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity').GetValue|2] goods_supply_added=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added').GetValue|2] estate_refund=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund').GetValue|2]"
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_store_monthly_reconciliation_record_good_wheat = yes
}

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_wheat = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_wheat = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_wheat = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_wheat = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_wheat = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_wheat = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_wheat = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_maize = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:maize
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:maize
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

			name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier
			value = {
				value = "variable_map(modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier|goods:maize)"

modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_maize = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_to_write
		value = {
			value = $value$
			min = 0.0001
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			is_key_in_variable_map = {
				name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
				target = goods:maize
			}
		}
		remove_from_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:maize
		}
	}
	add_to_variable_map = {
		name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
		key = goods:maize
		value = scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_to_write

modeu5_annual_adjust_location_pop_demand_good_maize = {
	modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_maize = yes
	modeu5_get_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_maize = yes
	modeu5_read_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_maize = yes

	if = {
		limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months >= 12
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months = 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 1.01
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_satisfied_months = 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_unsatisfied_months >= 12
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				value = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_value
					multiply = 0.99
					min = 0.0001
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied value = 2 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_adjustment_applied > 0 }
			modeu5_write_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_maize = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_multiplier_present > 0 }
				modeu5_write_pop_demand_multiplier_good_maize = {
					value = scope:modeu5_us04_new_reconciliation_coefficient
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_reset_pop_demand_annual_counters_good_maize = yes
}

modeu5_initialize_pop_demand_multiplier_good_rice = {
	# Legacy PR69 vanilla-injection coefficient. EU5 1.2+ runtime probes showed
	# that scripts cannot update engine pop_demand x good reliably, but the
	# versioned seed remains as archived experimental state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
						target = goods:rice
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_pop_demand_multiplier
			key = goods:rice
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

modeu5_initialize_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_good_rice = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_variable_map = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient
						target = goods:rice
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient
			key = goods:rice
			value = "modeu5_pop_demand_base_consumption_multiplier"
		}
	}
}

modeu5_get_pop_demand_multiplier_good_rice = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_multiplier_present value = 0 }
	# Missing or invalid legacy state must fall back to multiplier 1, which
	# leaves the complete vanilla Pop-demand coefficient unchanged.
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_old_multiplier value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {

			debug_log = "ModeU5 US-04 RECONCILED good=rice requested=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity').GetValue|2] extra=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_extra_quantity').GetValue|2] removed=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_removed_quantity').GetValue|2] goods_supply_removed=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_removed').GetValue|2] estate_charge=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_charge').GetValue|2]"
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_coefficient_present > 0
			scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity > 0
			exists = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			exists = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			scope:modeu5_us04_proxy_estate_source_present > 0
			modeu5_stock_runtime_ready_trigger = yes
		}
		modeu5_read_country_stock_record = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = rice
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_country_stock_before_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_country_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_market_stock_before_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_market_stock }

		modeu5_add_stock = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = rice
			quantity = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity
			capacity_policy = allow_over_capacity
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_actual_added_quantity }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_goods_supply_delta value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity > 0 }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market = {
				add_goods_supply = {
					goods = goods:rice
					amount = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_delta
				}
			}
		}

		modeu5_read_country_stock_record = {
			country = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country
			market = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market
			good = rice
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_country_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation value = scope:modeu5_read_market_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_country_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market_stock_delta value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_after_reconciliation subtract = scope:modeu5_us04_market_stock_before_reconciliation min = 0 } }

		scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_market = {
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				value = { value = "market_price(goods:rice)" min = 0 }
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value
			value = {
				value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity
				multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_good_price
				min = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value > 0
				scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity > 0
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_peasants_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_burghers_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_nobles_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate value = { value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value multiply = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity_clergy_estate divide = scope:modeu5_us04_restore_reconciliation_quantity min = 0 } }
			scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_country = {
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:peasants_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_peasants_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_burghers_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_nobles_estate } }
				if = { limit = { scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate > 0 } add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:clergy_estate value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_clergy_estate } }
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { modeu5_audit_enabled_trigger = yes }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_monthly_requested_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity value = scope:modeu5_us04_actual_restored_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added value = scope:modeu5_us04_goods_supply_added_quantity }
			set_variable = { name = modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund value = scope:modeu5_us04_reconciliation_estate_refund_value }
			debug_log = "ModeU5 US-04 RESTORED good=rice requested=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_requested_quantity').GetValue|2] restored=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_restored_quantity').GetValue|2] goods_supply_added=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_goods_supply_added').GetValue|2] estate_refund=[THIS.GetVariable('modeu5_debug_us04_last_estate_refund').GetValue|2]"
		}
	}

	modeu5_us04_store_monthly_reconciliation_record_good_rice = yes
}
